A complete phone outline sits inside the separate stethoscope tubing; the medical instrument acts as an associated modifier rather than a phone part.

## Visual draft

A tall rounded phone sits between the upward ends of a stethoscope. The tubing curves beneath the phone, then loops down and right toward a round chestpiece beside its lower edge.

## 1. Empty Smartphone (container)

An upright smartphone with rounded corners, a blank screen, and a lower strip with a short home mark. Exclude all dollar signs, speech bubbles, location pins, and stethoscope tubing.

## 2. Stethoscope (sub)

An open U-shaped stethoscope tube descends into a loop ending at a circular chestpiece on the right. Exclude the smartphone.
